description: This file defines the VacancyAttachmentDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for VacancyAttachment entities in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to access file content and associate vacancies by ID, utilizing traits and other entity classes.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for VacancyAttachment entities, providing additional methods for content retrieval and vacancy association.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a VacancyAttachment entity.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of the attachment, handling string and resource types, caching the content if resource.

methods.name: setVacancyById
methods.description: Sets the vacancy for the attachment based on vacancy ID, retrieving reference via ORM methods.
